summary: ```markdown # CLO Skills Teaching Mini-Class: How to Make a Sequin Skirt ## Introduction In this mini-class, we will explore the steps to create a sparkling sequin skirt. This project is perfect for those looking to enhance their sewing skills while creating a stylish garment. ## Materials Needed Before we begin, ensure you have the following materials: - Sequined fabric - Lining fabric - Sewing machine - Thread matching the fabric - Scissors - Measuring tape - Pins - Iron ## Step-by-Step Instructions ### 1. Measuring and Cutting the Fabric Start by taking your measurements. Measure your waist, hips, and the desired length of the skirt. Once you have your measurements, carefully cut the sequined fabric and the lining fabric according to your measurements. ### 2. Preparing the Fabric After cutting, it’s essential to prepare the fabric. Iron the lining to remove any wrinkles, and ensure the sequined fabric is laid flat for easy sewing. ### 3. Sewing the Skirt Begin sewing the sequined fabric together, paying close attention to the seams. Use a straight stitch to secure the fabric, and reinforce the seams for added durability. After the main fabric is assembled, sew the lining to the inside of the skirt. ### 4. Adding Finishing Touches To give your skirt a polished look, consider adding a waistband. You can also hem the bottom of the skirt to prevent fraying and create a clean finish. ## Conclusion Once your skirt is complete, try it on and make any necessary adjustments. Enjoy your new sequin skirt, and feel free to experiment with different colors and styles! ## Final Remarks Thank you for joining this mini-class. Happy sewing, and I’ll see you next time! ```
